projects.title: The Future of Hiring
projects.description: Maxxhire came to us with a vision - to become the leading startup for remote hiring. A tough, long and challenging road ahead, but when spiced with love, wit and fun, yields amazing results.

data.content: Maxxhire is an innovative recruitment platform that simplifies global hiring for remote companies through tailored automation and data-driven solutions.

To launch their services effectively, they sought our expertise in creating their identity and executing a comprehensive branding and marketing strategy, for companies and talent in the competitive HR tech landscape.

In our work with Maxxhire, we designed a logo that captures the essence of modern technology and connectivity. The deep blue color symbolizes loyalty, wisdom, and depth, representing the calm and constancy Maxxhire aims to deliver.

The logo’s design is a masterful blend of elements: the letter "M" subtly resembles a mouse cursor, while the infinity symbol and bow tie shape merge to signify boundless possibilities and sophisticated balance.
Maxxhire set an ambitious goal to increase their Instagram followers to 2,000 within a month.

Thanks to our strategic partnership and targeted social media strategy, we far exceeded this goal, reaching 3,000 followers in just a week and a half. After six months, Maxxhire’s follower count soared to 15.2k.

data.text: Remote or Office? A Dynamic Animation Journey

data.content: For Maxxhire, we developed a series of captivating animations that differentiated between office-based and remote work through compelling visual storytelling.
Using sleek transitions and bold imagery, we illustrated the flexibility and diversity of Maxxhire’s recruitment solutions.
By contrasting office environments with remote setups, we emphasized the brand's ability to seamlessly connect top talent with opportunities anywhere in the world.
